pins.title: Cooling Mattress Topper vs Cooling Pillow for Night Sweats: Which to Try First?
pins.subtitle: Start with where you feel the heat
pins.description: Pillows cool a small zone; toppers cover the whole sleep surface. If the heat stays at your face, scalp, and neck, a cooling pillow is the lower-effort place to start. If it spreads to your back, legs, or the mattress itself, a pillow can't reach that. Cooling bedding won't stop a hot flash, but it may make it easier to settle back to sleep. Not medical advice. #menopausesleep #nightsweats #coolingpillow #mattresstopper #hotflashes

pins.title: Do Cooling Pillows Stay Cold All Night? What to Expect Before Buying for Menopause
pins.subtitle: Cool to the touch is not cold all night
pins.description: A common misconception: no cooling pillow stays cold indefinitely. Gel-infused foams and cooling covers usually feel cool at first and gradually equalize to body temperature, though they generally still run cooler than standard memory foam. Look for a washable cover and a trial or return policy, since cooling comfort is subjective. If night sweats are frequent or severe, talk with a healthcare provider. Not medical advice. #coolingpillow #menopause #nightsweats #hotsleeper
